body.message:
Hi Fam Living,

Hope you’re all doing well.

We’re writing to let you know that we’ll be moving to a new home and would like to discuss the possibility of checking out earlier than our current booking end date.

Our stay is currently booked until 10 August, however we’re planning to move out sometime between 1–3 August. We were wondering if it would be possible to check out early and receive a refund for the remaining unused days of our booking. As the apartment would be available sooner, we thought it may also give you the opportunity to accommodate another guest during that period.

We also wanted to ask when we could expect our security deposit to be returned after we check out, assuming everything is in order following the inspection.

We’d really appreciate it if you could let us know what options are available regarding both the early check-out and any potential refund.

Thank you very much, and we look forward to hearing from you.

Kind regards
